props.body: Ground Level Contracting is a commercial excavation and civil infrastructure company based in Barrie, Ontario. We serve project managers and site supervisors across Barrie, Midland, Orillia, Innisfil, Wasaga Beach, and all of Simcoe County. We specialize in preparing land for development — solving complex geotechnical challenges efficiently and safely so your build proceeds on schedule and on budget. With 15+ years of field experience and 500+ commercial projects completed, our licensed and insured crews are built for the complexity and accountability that B2B construction relationships demand.

props.intro: Ground Level Contracting delivers the full scope of civil infrastructure for commercial builds across Barrie, Midland, Orillia, Innisfil, Wasaga Beach, and Simcoe County — from first cuts on the ground through utilities, drainage, and winter operations.

props.body: Simcoe County geology — rock, clay, high water table — eliminates underprepared contractors. GLC mobilizes commercial-grade equipment, licensed operators, and the project coordination depth that tight commercial timelines demand.

reasons.title: Rapid Site Mobilization
reasons.text: Equipment and crews reach any Simcoe County site within hours of call. When your pour date is fixed, we're on-site — no extended lead times, no delays.

reasons.title: Geotechnical Field Depth
reasons.text: Rock, clay, and high water table are our daily realities. We diagnose site conditions before they become change orders and adapt in the field — not on a call with the office.

reasons.title: Direct Project Manager Line
reasons.text: One number. Same-day updates, clean documentation, and sign-offs that keep your project files tight. We speak GC and PM fluently — no coordination gaps.

reasons.title: Single-Source Scope Control
reasons.text: Excavation, septic & utility digs, foundations, drainage, clearing, hauling — one contractor across all scopes. Fewer handoffs, tighter coordination, one number to call.

steps.title: Site Consultation
steps.desc: Call or email us with your site address, scope, and timeline. We review ground conditions and site constraints, then provide a clear assessment — no vague estimates.

steps.title: Detailed Quote
steps.desc: We deliver transparent, itemized pricing with no hidden costs. Every line item is confirmed before any equipment moves — because your project budget matters as much as your schedule.

steps.title: Crew Mobilization
steps.desc: Our operators and equipment mobilize to your Barrie, Midland, Orillia, or Simcoe County site efficiently. Safety protocols are locked in on day one, and your site super has a direct line to our crew lead.

steps.title: Delivery & Signoff
steps.desc: Work is completed to spec, all site documentation is delivered, and signoff is confirmed. Your concrete pour, framing, or next trade can proceed on schedule — that's the Ground Level guarantee.
